steps.note: Open the closest available prepared buyer Responses screen with a vendor bid.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are enabled for the tenant.
Ensure eRFX project functionality is enabled for the tenant.
Send the supported single-price counter offer on the vendor's own bid.
Assert that the buyer grid marks the vendor's bid as having a counter offer.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer can be accepted.
Have the vendor accept the pending buyer counter offer.
Return to the buyer's Responses view.
Assert that the buyer grid marks the vendor's counter offer as accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the resulting comparison values.
Assert that the displayed Master QCS amounts follow the current rate multiplied by quantity.
